description: Golden cases for .claude/skills/architecture-review (Frappe edition). Each case is a requirement; the skill must produce an ADR that follows docs/adr/0000-template.md, cites the real spice_lite code (and Frappe source where the decision depends on it), decides the Frappe axes (core vs country app vs integration app; controller vs doc_events; sync vs frappe.enqueue), and names the risks specific to this codebase. facts[] lists line-level facts (read: from the code, run: measured on the bench) so a grader can check an ADR by hand.
howToRun: rm docs/adr/<new-file>.md   # golden runs must not leave ADRs behind
matching: mustCite: each entry must appear as a cited path (substring). mustMention: each entry (or one of a list of alternatives) must appear, case-insensitive. mustNotMention: must not appear. minOptions/minRisks: row counts in the Options and Risks tables.

cases.input: The Kenya deployment must store a national health ID per patient, search patients by it through search_patients, return it in the Patient resource, and verify it against the national client registry (an external API with outages). Other countries do not use it yet.
facts: read: overview.md:40 country-specific behaviour belongs in a country app
read: spice-lite-glossary.md:15 an integration app has required_apps = ["spice_lite"] and connects e.g. a national ID service
read: fhir.py:33 PATIENT_FIELDS is a fixed list, so a Custom Field never reaches the API
run: mappers.parse_token('urn:spice:ke:nhid|12345678') returns '12345678' (system dropped), which fhir.py:80-81 searches as an MRN
read: hooks.py:11 required_apps = [] and no doc_events
read: frappe rq_job.py:170 shows job kwargs in desk (arguments=frappe.as_json(job.kwargs))
read: frappe base_document.py:409-412 blank unique values are stored as NULL

cases.input: search_patients returns at most 50 patients. Add cursor pagination so clients can fetch the next page of a family-name search, with a stable order.
facts: read: fhir.py:34 MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS = 50; fhir.py:87-88 order_by last_name asc, name asc, limit_page_length
read: mappers.py:87 Bundle total is len(resources), not the match count
read: sl_patient.json last_name has search_index but there is no index on (last_name, name)
read: frappe.get_list takes limit_start (offset); a keyset condition (last_name > X) or (last_name = X and name > Y) cannot be written with filters/or_filters, and frappe.qb would bypass permissions
read: a cursor that encodes last_name puts PHI into URLs and access logs

cases.input: Follow-up calls are made through a telephony provider. Record each call against the patient's SL Encounter; the provider posts a webhook when a call ends and the recording must be downloaded.
facts: read: glossary integration app row names telephony
read: phi-and-secrets-policy.md:14 integration users authenticate with an API key and secret; no allow_guest on clinical data (frappe-coding-standards.md#3)
read: sl_encounter.py has only validate and on_update; call logic belongs in the integration app's doc_events or its own DocType
read: recording download is slow external I/O: frappe.enqueue on the long queue (1500 s) with job_id per call

cases.input: When an SL Encounter is set to finished, create a billable item in the country's ERPNext instance.
facts: read: overview.md:4 ERPNext is an external integration target, not part of the clinical core
read: sl_encounter.py validate requires encounter_date when status is finished
read: frappe-coding-standards.md:9 background work through frappe.enqueue with job_id and deduplicate; never slow external calls inside a web request

cases.input: Make spice_lite.api.fhir.lastn use a constant number of queries regardless of how many subjects are requested, without weakening permissions.
facts: run: 1, 5, 20 subjects cost 2, 10, 40 queries on Postgres
read: fhir.py:177 frappe.get_all ignores User Permissions and permission_query_conditions; frappe.qb window functions also bypass permissions
read: fhir.py:174 uses (>, 1900-01-01) because (is, set) fails on Postgres (D-2)
run: FrappeTestCase.assertQueryCount raises TypeError on Postgres in Frappe v15.121.2; a query counter is needed
read: test_fhir_api.py test_lastn_returns_latest_per_patient must keep passing

cases.input: A regional deployment will serve three countries from one site. Clinicians may only see patients and observations of their own country.
facts: read: overview.md:4 today the platform runs one deployment per country; this requirement changes that assumption
read: sl_patient.json country is a Link to SL Country with search_index, so User Permissions on SL Country can restrict SL Patient
read: permission_query_conditions applies to frappe.get_list only; fhir.py:177 lastn uses frappe.get_all
read: a has_permission Frappe hook can only deny, never grant

cases.input: We need real FHIR conformance: replace the FHIR-lite whitelisted methods with a conformant FHIR server app.
facts: read: docs/adr/0001-fhir-lite-over-whitelisted-methods.md is accepted and decided the opposite
read: every endpoint lives in spice_lite/api/fhir.py with pure mappers in api/mappers.py
